title: Celestial Bodies

vibeProfile.oneLine: Three sisters live through Oman's leap from tradition into the oil age.

summary: In the Omani village of al-Awafi, three sisters and the households around them live through a country's rapid passage from a world of slavery and tradition into oil-era modernity. Told in shifting voices and jumps through time, Alharthi's novel builds a rich, non-linear family saga about marriage, loss and social change in a corner of the world rarely mapped in fiction. Quiet and demanding in the best way, it became the first novel originally written in Arabic to win the International Booker Prize.
whyReadIt: A quietly ambitious family saga from Oman, unlike anything else on the shelf. A window onto a world English fiction rarely reaches.

funFacts.text: It was the first Arabic novel to win the International Booker Prize, in 2019.
